name: auto_review_candidates
description: Run conservative heuristic auto-review across pending memory entries and rule candidates. Returns the standard summary shape (auto_confirmed / auto_rejected / kept_pending / needs_user_confirmation). With apply=true, low-risk decisions are applied with audit events while ambiguous or high-risk items stay reviewable. Apply mode also completes Agent-consumed distill tasks and triggers Dream.

apply.description: When true, apply auto_confirm / auto_reject decisions. When false (default), preview without writes.
